summary: Longeveron Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report restoration of Nasdaq compliance. Following the March resignation of a director and election of three new directors at the July annual meeting, the Board reconstituted the Audit Committee on July 24, 2026. The new committee comprises Dr. Deborah Ascheim, Leah Rush Cann, George Paletta, and Ursula Ungaro, all independent, with Cann qualifying as an audit committee financial expert. This cures the prior audit committee composition deficiency. This is routine governance and compliance disclosure, not a special situation.
